 Print NTA advises candidates to complete Aadhaar re-KYC before registration The National Testing Agency ( NTA ) has advised Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main 2027 Session 1 candidates to complete Aadhaar re-KYC through DigiLocker before filling out the online application form. The agency has issued guidelines to help candidates avoid problems with identity verification and biometric data during the registration process and later stages of the examination. According to the advisory released on the official website, candidates must use their own DigiLocker, JanParichay or e-Pramaan (MeriPehchaan) login credentials while applying. They should also ensure that their name and date of birth in the application form match the details given in their Class 10 certificate or marksheet. The JEE Main 2027 Session 1 application form is available on the official website, jeemain.nta.nic.in. Candidates are advised to check the website regularly for further updates and instructions. JEE Main 2027: Guidelines issued by NTA
 The NTA has asked candidates to follow these instructions while completing the application process: Complete Aadhaar re-KYC: Candidates should update their Aadhaar details through DigiLocker before filling out the application form.
 Use personal login credentials: Applicants must log in through their own DigiLocker, JanParichay or e-Pramaan (MeriPehchaan) accounts.
 Check personal details: The name and date of birth entered in the application form must match the Class 10 certificate or marksheet.
 Check official updates: Candidates should visit the NTA website regularly for new notices and examination-related information.
 Following these instructions can help candidates avoid issues during identity verification at later stages of the examination process. How to complete Aadhaar re-KYC through DigiLocker
 Candidates can follow these steps to complete Aadhaar re-KYC through DigiLocker: Sign in to DigiLocker: Log in to your DigiLocker account and open the 'Issued Documents' section.
 Find the Aadhaar document: Locate your Aadhaar card in the list of issued documents.
 Select the refresh option: Click the three-dot menu next to the Aadhaar document and select 'Refresh' to start the re-KYC process.
 Give consent: Read the consent screen and allow Aadhaar authentication to continue.
 Enter the OTP: Enter the one-time password (OTP) sent to the mobile number registered with Aadhaar.
 Complete authentication: Wait for the re-KYC process to finish successfully.
 Refresh other documents: Once Aadhaar re-KYC is complete, refresh other documents in DigiLocker to update their status.
 The appearance of the options may vary slightly depending on the version of the DigiLocker application being used. JEE Main 2027 exam dates 
 The NTA will conduct JEE Main 2027 in two sessions. Session 1 is scheduled for January 2027, while Session 2 will take place in April 2027. Candidates applying for Session 1 should complete the registration process carefully and check all details before submitting the application form. Read official notice here.
